newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Ex-Argentine economy minister guilty of slander.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Argentine economy minister guilty of slander.

text.p: An Argentine judge gave former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo a four-month suspended jail sentence late Tuesday for slandering a former customs official.
Cavallo vowed to appeal the decision. "I disagree absolutely with the verdict but I expected it," Cavallo told reporters.
Lawyer Jorge Kolon sued Cavallo over corruption allegations dating back to 1992, which he says got him fired from his job in the customs office and prevented him from being appointed a judge.
"I am satisfied that justice has been done," Kolon said. "The suit demonstrated the how false Cavallo's charges were. I wanted to show my innocence and therefore I am satisified."
